Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We pushed an internal readout and have three asks before we can route for signatures:

1) Final mutual action plan (we made a couple small changes to milestone 2 dates)
2) A clean SOW (one-page summary + deliverables) we can attach to PO
3) A quick signature roster and suggested routing order (we need CISO and Head of Ops on the signer list)

Can your team deliver the final MAP and SOW by EOD Tuesday (9/15)? If so we’ll lock the proposed start date to the first week of October. If there’s any blocker on your side, call it out — we can shift the start but want clarity for budgeting.

Also: do you have any constraints around DocuSign routing (multiple signers from our side, parallel or serial)?

Appreciate it —
Samir
Senior Director, Strategic Ops
Orbit Commerce

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the timeline with a small ask for alignment on two items. Proposed plan below: 

Plan (high level) — timeline to signatures
- Today (9/11): Redwood to review your MAP edits and return a redlined MAP + clean PDF SOW for PO attachment (Marissa)
- 9/12–9/13: Legal/procurement review (Karthik) — quick redline window
- 9/14–9/15 EOD: Final internal approvals + confirm signer roster (Orbit)
- 9/16: DocuSign packet goes out (serial routing: Orbit CISO -> Orbit Head of Ops -> Orbit CFO, parallel for Redwood)
- Target kickoff: week of 2026-10-04 (preferred) — can compress to 2026-09-27 only if all approvals finish by 9/16

Questions / notes:
- Karthik: can you confirm we can accept Orbit’s standard PO language that references our SOW appendix, or do we need a separate procurement addendum?
- Samir / Leah: please confirm signer emails and whether you prefer serial or parallel routing. We’ll default to serial to avoid missing signatures.

Deliverables attached: Final_SOW_redwood.pdf (one-page summary + deliverables), Signature_Roster.csv (template). MAP redline attached inline (see MAP_OrbitCommerce_v3.xlsx).

Next steps: I’ll kick this off and expect the first internal redline from Karthik by tomorrow EOD. If anything threatens the 9/15 approval window I’ll escalate.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the SOW and the MAP edits. A couple of practical items from legal/procurement that will affect routing: 

- We can accept Orbit’s PO language with a short procurement addendum (I’ll draft a one-paragraph addendum that limits liability and clarifies data retention).
- For Private deployments or KMS requirements called out in SOW, we need a short appendix on key management (if Orbit requires HSM/KMS we must capture key custody).
- Signature roster: please confirm the exact signer emails and whether any of the Orbit signers require notarized signatures (unlikely but flagging).

DocuSign routing notes (recommended):
- Redwood parallel signers: Legal (karthik@redwood.com) + Sales Ops (marissa@redwood.com) — sign at same time
- Orbit serial routing: CISO -> Head of Ops -> CFO

I’ll put the procurement addendum in track changes and send to Marissa and Samir by EOD 9/13. Also, requesting approval deadline of 2026-09-15 23:59 PDT so we can circulate DocuSign on 9/16. If Orbit needs an earlier kick (9/27), we’ll need approvals by 9/12 — which is tight.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
